button.$description: Corner radius of the button (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2). TBD-10: "rounded" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Outline stroke width of the button (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2). TBD-11: "thick" has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value.
Neon glow of the button (BR-10, REQ-023 AC2). TBD-12: the glow has no values; this follows a placeholder, not a brand value. A disabled button shows no glow (REQ-023 AC5).

color.$description: Focus ring color of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

width.$description: Focus ring width of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

offset.$description: Gap between the button and its focus ring (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

style.$description: Focus ring line style of the button (REQ-024 AC1, ADR-0009).

bg.$description: Fill of the primary button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-11).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the primary button while hovered. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand pink (BR-01).

bgActive.$description: Fill of the primary button while pressed. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand pink (BR-01).

fg.$description: Label of the primary button: black on the pink fill (SPEC.md section 2.1, REQ-023 AC3).

border.$description: Outline color of the primary button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-10).

bg.$description: Fill of the secondary button: brand yellow (BR-02, BR-11).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the secondary button while hovered. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand yellow (BR-02).

bgActive.$description: Fill of the secondary button while pressed. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand yellow (BR-02).

fg.$description: Label of the secondary button: black on the yellow fill (SPEC.md section 2.1).

border.$description: Outline color of the secondary button: brand yellow (BR-02, BR-10).

fg.$description: Label of the ghost button: brand pink on the page (BR-01, BR-11).

fgHover.$description: Label of the ghost button while hovered or pressed: black on the pink fill (SPEC.md section 2.1).

bgHover.$description: Fill of the ghost button while hovered. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand pink (BR-01).

bgActive.$description: Fill of the ghost button while pressed. TBD-08: no shade is defined, so it repeats the brand pink (BR-01).

border.$description: Outline color of the ghost button: brand pink (BR-01, BR-10).
